# Version 4.156.0
> **Rendering and lifetime reliability** · Released November 9, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.156.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 pairs Skia m156 rendering fixes with GTK4 GPU views and more reliable native resource lifetimes. Linux NoDependencies font discovery returns, Android continuous rendering follows display refresh, and Uno views move to Uno 7. Review the GTK4 coordinate changes, Uno migration, stricter input validation and higher Apple and Tizen requirements before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now paints in physical pixels by default on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical paint coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing storage. GTK input coordinates remain logical; RawInfo continues to describe physical pixels. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7** — The non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, removes RaiseOnUnsupported and uses a CPU canvas with a null GRContext on non-Windows targets. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage and use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required. The Windows App SDK facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher managed or framework requirements. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS, tvOS and Catalyst 14 native baselines in this release line. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Tizen applications to Tizen 10** — The new native packages require Tizen 10 and target net10.0-tizen10.0; Tizen 8 and 9 are no longer supported. Update application targets and manifests. Source builds require the Tizen 10 SDK with GCC 14.2 and support x64 and arm64, not the former 32-bit or Clang 10 paths. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU linking** — Newer WebAssembly consumers require libSkiaSharp.a to contain emdawnwebgpu's C++ support. Rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; pre-change and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this link contract. The port is no longer compiled on the application's final link line, avoiding C++20 flags on C sources. JavaScript glue remains a consumer link input, and the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Supply valid buffer lengths before calling native APIs** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the length exceeds the array. Encoded font APIs reject negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphId byte counts with ArgumentException. Pass lengths within the supplied buffer and complete 16-bit glyph IDs. Encoded BreakText results count bytes; string and char-span results count UTF-16 code units. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429), [#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Pass one encoded unit to GetUnicodeCharacterCode** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width instead of UTF-16 string length. Pass ASCII for UTF-8, a BMP character for UTF-16 or one Unicode scalar for UTF-32; use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Previously accepted multi-character UTF-32 strings are now rejected rather than silently returning the first character's code. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Replace the fork-specific WinRT native target** — The native fork retires its WinRT target. Move custom native builds using that target to a supported Windows target. Desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 with cumulative rendering corrections** — Updates the renderer to m156 and incorporates fixes for clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected zero-length hairline caps, glyph-atlas selection and glyph replay. The stable cut adds further path, clip and text corrections after the release candidate without changing managed API signatures. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5671](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5671))
- **More robust shaders and GPU transfers** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, contains failed shader pipelines and corrects conic-region storage sizing. Fixes GLES BGRA upload selection, Graphite stroke bounds and paint-key comparison, plus alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext and an opt-in render loop. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to request a frame. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux font discovery and shaping coexistence** — Restores installed-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies without adding fontconfig, scanning /usr/share/fonts by default. Separately, binds bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux to prevent crashes caused by system HarfBuzz symbol preemption after GTK initialization. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Continuous texture rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer display callbacks instead of running as fast as buffer swaps allow. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and pause, resize and reattachment retain lifecycle progress. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Consistent null string-buffer errors** — StringUtilities.GetString now throws ArgumentNullException, rather than NullReferenceException, for null byte arrays, matching its other byte-array overload. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Boolean callbacks match native widths** — Corrects Skia stream and image-provider callbacks and HarfBuzz font and Unicode callbacks to use their native boolean widths internally, including Apple ARM64 interpreter calls. Public managed delegates continue to use bool; false HarfBuzz glyph-name callbacks no longer copy a name buffer. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Release retained font and stream resources** — DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed. Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream releases its reference to a borrowed stream without disposing that stream; the caller still owns its disposal. This corrects retention rather than extending backing-data lifetime. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Safer native platform teardown** — Windows EGL teardown releases the view's native window, cached WGL pointers retain their OpenGL module, and native cleanup corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership. GTK4 disposes Skia surfaces before their Cairo pixel owners. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551), [#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Fewer temporary copy allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools the AddUtf32 string encoding buffer and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly assets match the target framework** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 3.1.34 archives for .NET 8, 3.1.56 for .NET 9 and 10, and 6.0.2 for .NET 11 and later. Single-threaded, multithreaded, SIMD and combined variants remain available. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Updated Windows rendering and asset selection** — Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7 for MAUI 9 and 10 compatibility, without raising the declared Windows runtime minimum. AnyCPU native imports now select portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs in place of legacy win10-* branches. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 keeps the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine; the package revision distinguishes the Skia milestone. It reduces AddUtf32 and feature-string allocations, corrects native boolean callback widths, aligns WebAssembly archives with .NET 11 and raises Apple and Tizen platform floors alongside SkiaSharp.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 4, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 adds Uno 7 support, display-paced Android rendering and fixes for custom-font, stream and callback lifetimes. It also raises Apple deployment floors, tightens buffer validation and corrects Linux HarfBuzz symbol binding.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10...v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK4 painting defaults to physical pixels, WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11 and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0...v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)
